messages:
tara: Proposal: define connector failover contract for VPC-isolated customers. Two supported modes: relay-only vs outbound-connector with relay fallback. Thoughts?
nish: prefer explicit failover rules. Suggest state machine: CONNECTED -> DEGRADED -> FALLBACK -> RECOVERY -> CONNECTED.
leo: metrics needed: failover_count, last_failover_ts, current_path, probe_latency. Also need a console kill-switch.
hannah: cert bootstrapping for on-prem: support one-time bootstrap token + periodic short-lived certs. Document airgap doc separately.
infra-bot: ci:connector v3.0 pushed to staging (sha:ff12ab)
tara: sketch config: connector.mode=hybrid, probe.interval=20s, degrade_threshold=3, fallback_min=90s, retry_backoff=30s.
nish: add hysteresis to avoid flapping: require 2 consecutive degraded windows before fallback.
leo: security: TLS passthrough by default. Termination only if customer opts in + audit log.
hannah: rollout: new accounts default hybrid; existing relay customers unchanged unless they opt-in. Run chaos test tearing control channel for 5m in staging.
tara: action items: RFC update (tara), cert bootstrap spec (hannah), metrics schema (leo), chaos plan (nish). I'll draft RFC tomorrow AM.
